title: Close the remaining live-proof gaps from Sprint 5 without overlapping W5-12 or slowdown investigation lanes
objective: Run a focused residual SIT proof round for the specific W5 gaps that remained open after the main batch proof: W5-01 full real processed-row round trip, W5-03 first-login / credential-flow proof, and W5-05 Review Mapping filename-first proof with a real processed document row.
why_this_exists: The first W5 SIT proof round was good enough to close many items, but the board still correctly marks W5-01 as only partial, W5-03 first-login behavior as still open, and W5-05 filename-first proof as not yet exercised with a real processed row.
These are proof gaps, not necessarily new implementation work. They deserve a clean, isolated follow-up prompt so they do not get lost inside W5-12 or the processing-slowdown investigation.

allowed_scope: Use the existing deployed dev/SIT runtime or redeploy via approved Openclaw workflow only if needed
Live browser proof, route checks, runtime verification, and screenshot/network evidence
Small proof-oriented scripts or docs artifacts
forbidden_scope: Do not implement W5-12 line-item/export-realdata product changes
Do not turn this into the slowdown investigation lane
Do not widen scope into COA glyph repair, dashboard redesign, or unrelated app-code refactors
Do not claim W5-12 closed from this proof round

residual_items_to_close.goal: Prove one full real processed-row Upload -> Processing -> Review Scan -> Review Mapping -> Export round trip on SIT
residual_items_to_close.why_open: Previous proof showed upload + task start + review screens opening, but still had 0 rows in Review Scan / Review Mapping.

residual_items_to_close.goal: Prove the actual first-login / temp-password / must-change-password flow for an admin/sys_admin path
residual_items_to_close.why_open: Previous proof closed create/badge/company-name/deactivate, but did not explicitly prove the login/first-login behavior.

residual_items_to_close.goal: Prove Review Mapping is filename-first with a real processed document row
residual_items_to_close.why_open: Previous proof had no processed row in Review Mapping, so the filename-first rendering was not exercised live.

what_to_do: 1. Use the current SIT deployment if it still matches the required code, or redeploy via Openclaw workflow only if necessary.
2. Run one processing proof with a real sample file and wait long enough for an actual document row to reach Review Scan and Review Mapping.
3. Capture proof that the document row in Review Mapping uses the uploaded filename as the primary label, with invoice number only secondary if present.

4. Create a fresh user that receives a temp password / must-change-password path, then prove the first-login behavior end to end: first login, password change if required, and stable subsequent access behavior.
5. From the same real processed document path, complete the minimal round trip through Export so W5-01 is not left at screen-navigation level only.
6. Return a concise pass/partial/fail result for W5-01, W5-03A, and W5-05 with screenshots and network/runtime evidence.
acceptance_criteria: W5-01 is only PASS if at least one real processed document row is observed moving through Review Scan and Review Mapping before Export.
W5-03A is only PASS if first-login / temp-password behavior is explicitly exercised, not inferred.
W5-05 is only PASS if Review Mapping shows a real document row whose primary visible label is the uploaded filename.
The report clearly states whether any remaining gap is a proof limitation, a runtime issue, or an app-code issue.
The report explicitly states that W5-12 and slowdown investigation were out of scope for this prompt.
final_instruction_to_copilot: Close the residual proof gaps only. Do not drift into W5-12 implementation or the processing slowdown investigation. This prompt succeeds by proving or disproving the remaining live behavior, not by broadening scope.
